meta.name: Midcentury Editorial Web Design System
meta.source: Midcentury modern editorial UI with Aqua Blue integrated as a primary accent.
meta.intendedUse: Design system JSON for development and theming.

designPrinciples: Editorial first: typography and imagery lead.
Midcentury restraint paired with coastal-modern Aqua Blue.
Few colors, large planes, confident whitespace.
Hierarchy through scale, asymmetry, and color.
Aqua Blue is the dominant interactive accent.

usageGuidelines.primaryAccent: Aqua Blue (#5FB3B3) is the main accent for interaction and emphasis.
usageGuidelines.cta: Primary CTAs use aqua.primary with white text; hover uses aqua.deep.
usageGuidelines.highlight: Use aqua.soft for caption panels and callouts.
usageGuidelines.navigation: Active nav and focus states use aqua.primary.
usageGuidelines.balance: Aqua Blue should visually outweigh sunflower and complement cobalt.
